title: Brass band music returning from the cemetery; Excelsior solos and Pajeaud
summary: On the way back bands played hymns and then hot numbers. The Excelsior knew who would solo, and Dejan says Willie Pajeaud struggled to get the Eureka to rehearse.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs
